QuestInfo.name: Where's Kaiser?
QuestInfo.0: You are told that #b#p3000002##k, the leader of the Nova council, has found Kaiser. Maybe that's why Kaiser has been absent lately. Go to Pantheon and see #b#p3000002##k.
QuestInfo.1: Oh dear Cygnus! #b#p3000002##k sent Kaiser to the Heliseum Reclamation HQ without even consulting anyone else! Hurry and get to the portal to the Heliseum Reclamation HQ!
QuestInfo.2: You met a Nova scout named #b#p3001007##k, who requested help near the portal at the HQ.

no.0: Oh, I thought the fate of the Nova race would be a bit more important to you.

yes.0: I don't know who you are... but we're in big trouble!
